parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

The ID can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
订阅的应用ID。
应用ID由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大64字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.

The ID can be up to 55 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
任务ID由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大55字符
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom SEI.

The value is a JSON string that can be up to 4,096 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
自定义SEI。
自定义SEI为json字符串，不超过4096个字符
parameters.name: custom_sei
